p.s: Successful people take risks at every turn of their lives.
They tend to do the unthinkable because normal people are sometimes afraid, ashamed, shy or feel guilty doing things that others have not done.
In my opinion the one who dreams and does nothing to acheive that dream of his is not successful.
successful people dream and try and try and try to reach their respective goal inspite of the difficulties facing them.
i will give you certain examples regarding that.
A few days back i was watching news about a handicapped woman who couldnot walk since she was young.
she attended college and by her sheer perseverance and hard work, she was able to make it to the basketball team and is representing USA in world cup championship.
when she was interviewed as to how she could do it, she just replied HARD WORK and RISK.
The other example that i can think of is the guys who created YOUTUBE.
who would have thought that these guys ( 3 in all ) would make millions and millions with their NEW innovation.
that is what i call risk.
they risked their future by rejecting job offers from other companies and starting a new innovation called youtube and the results are there for everyone to see.
one more example that i would think of is india 's mittal company.
Indian steel companies never ventured outside india.
But mittal comapany made a bold move of purchasing britain 's premier oil company.
Everybody thought that this move was a big blunder.
But the companys risk proved to be the best deal ( and big too ) and many indian companies now are moving globally.
so, with above examples in mind i really think that successful people try new things and take risks rather than doing what they already know.
